Good to plan

National Day falls in the busiest weeks.

The Eid Al Etihad public holiday in 2026 is on 2 and 3 December. Offices usually celebrate in the last working days before the holiday, which overlaps with the start of year-end party season, so book early.

Arabic coffee and dates for guests, a generous rice dish at the centre, grills and salads, and luqaimat to finish make a classic National Day spread. Tell us whether you want an Emirati-inspired menu, a mix of cuisines that reflects your team, or both.

Questions

Good to know.

When is UAE National Day 2026?

The Eid Al Etihad public holiday in 2026 is on 2 and 3 December.

When do offices hold National Day celebrations?

Usually in the last working days before the holiday. Book early, because those days overlap with year-end party season.

Can you cater an Emirati-inspired menu?

Yes. We build Arabic and Emirati-inspired menus, and can mix in other cuisines to suit your guests.

Do you cater community and school events?

We cater community and campus events where outside catering is allowed. Tell us the venue and headcount.

Is your food halal?

Yes. All our catering menus are 100% halal.

Planning help

Before you book.

How much food per person for catering?

Quantities per guest for rice, mains, sides, bread, desserts and drinks, with a calculator for your headcount.
